schema: Anthropic long-running-agent feature list (category / description / steps / passes), extended with id / blockedBy / refs. See https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-harnesses-for-long-running-agents
instructions: Edit ONLY the `passes` field of a feature, and flip it to true ONLY after carefully testing every step. Never delete, weaken, or merge a feature to make it pass. Work the highest-priority feature whose blockedBy are all passing. UI-only: do not modify strata-daemon (ADR-0003).

features.title: Empty visor
features.description: The extension installs, enables, and supervises the Strata daemon; Ctrl+Alt+C makes a full-width, fixed-height empty visor appear instantly at the configured edge and toggle away.
steps: gnome-extensions enable activates the extension with no errors in the journal
Ctrl+Alt+C instantly shows a full-width band (~360px) at the bottom edge and toggles it away on the same key; no slide animation
Escape and focus-loss dismiss the visor
The daemon is spawned if absent, supervised with exponential-backoff restart, and NOT double-spawned when a systemd instance already owns dev.edu4rdshl.Strata

features.title: Shelf from history
features.description: The visor renders clipboard history as a horizontal shelf of fixed-width Text cards, newest first, paginated from the daemon and loading more as you scroll toward the end.
steps: On open, the first page (page-size, default 50) loads via GetHistory(0, pageSize) and renders as ~300x280 cards, ~6 visible on 1080p
Scrolling within ~200px of the end fetches the next page; the full table never sits in JS memory
Rows are inserted in idle_add batches (~20) so a page never freezes a frame
Card text uses St.Label only (no set_markup)

features.title: Image thumbnails
features.description: Image entries show a thumbnail on their card, fetched on demand only for visible cards and cached to disk.
steps: Image cards render a placeholder first, then load the ~200px PNG via GetThumbnail(id) for visible cards only
Thumbnails are cached at ~/.cache/strata/thumbnails/<id>.png and reused (session Map + disk)
Scrolling past off-screen image cards issues no D-Bus traffic for those rows
On ItemDeleted, the cached thumbnail file is unlinked

features.title: Search (FTS5 prefix)
features.description: Typing in the header search box filters the shelf via the daemon's FTS5 prefix search. Fuzzy search is deferred to v2 (ADR-0003).
steps: Search box is focused on open (search-first); typing filters results
Queries call SearchHistory(query, max-history) with a 150ms debounce and an epoch guard that drops stale responses
Empty query restores the recent-history browse view
Results render through the same paged/idle_add mechanism as browse mode

features.title: Select & copy-and-dismiss
features.description: Choosing a card copies that entry to the system clipboard and dismisses the visor. No auto-paste (ADR-0005).
steps: Enter copies the focused card (or the top result if focus is still in search) and closes the visor
Alt+1...9 copies the Nth visible card and closes
Paste-back fetches GetItemContent(id): text via St.Clipboard.set_text, binary via Meta.SelectionSourceMemory + set_owner
No synthetic paste is ever sent to another app
move-activated-to-top is honored when the setting is on

features.title: Peek (Space)
features.description: Space enlarges the focused card into a Peek: full text (syntax-highlighted for code) or a full-resolution image.
steps: Space on a text/code card shows the full content large; code is syntax-highlighted (highlight.js) ONLY here, never on the shelf
Space on an image card shows the full-resolution image, decoded on demand via GetItemContent (one image, on keypress)
Space again or Escape dismisses the Peek back to the shelf
Highlighting/decoding happens only for the single Peeked entry

features.title: Card renderers (URL, color, file)
features.description: Non-plain-text entries get type-specific cards matching Strata's current behavior: URL, hex color, file(s). Cheap client-side regex; no code detection on the shelf (ADR-0007).
steps: Entries matching a URL render link-styled with the hostname as a subtitle
Entries matching #rgb / #rrggbb render a hex color swatch
uri-list / copied-files entries render filename(s) with an icon
Classification is cheap regex on the client; everything else stays a Text card

features.title: Settings (in-UI gear + layout keys)
features.description: A gear in the visor header opens the extension prefs directly, and the new layout keys are wired into the gschema and the visor.
steps: A gear button opens the prefs window via openPreferences() without going through the GNOME Extensions app (req #5)
Prefs expose visor-edge (top/bottom, default bottom), visor-height, card-width, plus the reused Strata keys (theme, max-history, size caps, keyboard-shortcut, excluded-apps)
Changing visor-edge/height/card-width updates the visor live or on next open
theme auto/light/dark applies via the class-toggle approach

features.title: Live updates (signals)
features.description: The shelf stays in sync with the daemon via its D-Bus signals.
steps: ItemAdded prepends a new card (debounced to coalesce bursts); entries from excluded-apps are dropped
ItemDeleted removes the card and unlinks its cached thumbnail
HistoryCleared empties the shelf and wipes the thumbnail cache directory

features.title: Capture clipboard from other apps
features.description: Copies made in other apps reach Strata. On GNOME the daemon's data-control monitor cannot bind (Mutter exposes neither ext- nor wlr-data-control, see strata-daemon/src/clipboard/monitor.rs), so the extension is the capture agent: it watches the Meta selection and forwards each new payload to the daemon via SubmitItem. Missed in v1 (only daemon supervision, proxy, focus tracking, and signals were lifted from strata@edu4rdshl.dev) so history only grew while the original extension was also enabled. Port _connectClipboardMonitor / _readClipboard / _pickMime + SubmitItem from strata@edu4rdshl.dev/extension.js.
steps: Copying text/image/uri-list in another app stores it: a Meta selection owner-changed read picks the best MIME (allowlist mirroring the daemon pick_mime / the original extension) and calls SubmitItem(mime, ay) with the raw bytes, off the main thread (transfer_async into a MemoryOutputStream, no synchronous base64)

Rapid clipboard writes are debounced (~50ms) and only one transfer_async is in flight at a time; payloads over the size cap (max-text-mb / max-image-mb) and x-kde-passwordManagerHint secrets are skipped
Size caps are pushed to the daemon via SetConfig on enable and when the keys change, so the History prefs take effect

TEST FIRST: verify.sh case 010 stubs _proxy.SubmitItemRemote to record (mime, bytes); drives the nested session clipboard (St.Clipboard.set_text for text, a SelectionSourceMemory owner for an image); asserts SubmitItem fires once per copy with the right mime and decoded bytes, that an over-cap payload and a passwordManagerHint offer are dropped, and statically that owner-changed + transfer_async + SubmitItem exist in extension.js. RED before impl (no capture today), GREEN after; 002 + 009 re-verified
Manual live smoke: with only strata-ui enabled, copy text in another app and confirm a new card appears

features.title: Keyboard navigation across the shelf (Left/Right)
features.description: Left/Right move the selection across the horizontal shelf. Live bug: the search entry's ClutterText consumes the arrow keys for its text cursor, so navigation never reaches the shelf and focus stays stuck in search. Fix: intercept Left/Right in the captured-event (capture) phase, like Space/Peek already is. Right enters the shelf from the search box; Left steps back off the first card to the search box. Trade: arrows navigate cards instead of moving the search cursor, which is expected for a launcher (Home/End/Backspace still edit the query).
steps: With the visor open and focus in the search box, Right moves key focus to the first card and Right again to the next; the target is scrolled into view
Left walks back through the cards and, stepping off the first card, returns focus to the search box (moveFocus returns a boolean the capture handler uses to hand focus back)
Arrow handling lives in the captured-event phase so the search entry never swallows it; the dead bubble-phase Left/Right block is removed

TEST FIRST: verify.sh case 011 opens with browse cards, focuses the search clutter_text, sends a REAL Right keystroke (nested_key Right), asserts global.stage key focus is now the first card; Right -> second card; Left x2 -> back in the search box. RED before impl (today the keystroke stays in search), GREEN after; 004 + 005 + 006 re-verified

features.title: Paste-back writes the chosen entry (end-to-end)
features.description: Choosing a card must place THAT entry on the system clipboard. Live bug: it pasted the most-recent entry instead. The 005 test only asserted the internal _lastWrite field, not the real clipboard, so the regression passed headlessly. This slice adds an end-to-end clipboard read-back test and fixes the cause. Suspect: activate() fires _pasteBack un-awaited and dismisses immediately (onPick), whereas the known-good original (strata@edu4rdshl.dev panel.js _onItemActivated) awaits GetItemContent and writes the clipboard BEFORE closing. Confirm against the live journal before settling on the fix.
steps: After activating a non-top card, the system clipboard actually holds THAT card's content (read back via St.Clipboard.get_text in the nested session), not the top-of-history entry

The clipboard write is not lost when the visor dismisses: GetItemContent resolves and the clipboard is set even though the visor closes (write before dismiss, matching the original _onItemActivated ordering)

TEST FIRST: verify.sh case 012 puts real items in the daemon (SubmitItem) so they exist, opens browse, activates a known non-top card, then READS the real nested-session clipboard (St.Clipboard.get_default().get_text) and asserts it equals that card's content (end-to-end, not just _lastWrite). RED if the bug reproduces headlessly, GREEN after. Only if the headless clipboard already comes back CORRECT is the bug session-specific — then, and only then, capture the live journal. 005 re-verified
Fallback live smoke (only if headless cannot reproduce): click an older entry, paste into a text editor, confirm it matches; capture journalctl '[Strata UI]' lines

features.title: Gear opens the preferences window (live)
features.description: The header gear hides the visor then calls openPreferences(); live, the visor closes but no prefs window appears. The likely cause is prefs.js failing to construct under the running GNOME's libadwaita (008 only node --check-ed it, which cannot catch a runtime Adw API change/removal, e.g. Adw.MessageDialog in the shortcut dialog). This IS headless-testable: drive the real prefs path against the nested shell and assert prefs.js loads without error. Harden _onGearClicked so a prefs failure is logged with the [Strata UI] prefix instead of failing silently.
steps: Clicking the gear opens the Strata UI prefs window (General + Privacy pages) and does not merely dismiss the visor
Any Adw API incompatibility in prefs.js for the running GNOME (48/49/50) is fixed; prefs.js constructs cleanly
_onGearClicked wraps openPreferences in try/catch and logs failures; opening prefs does not depend on the visor's modal still being up

TEST FIRST: verify.sh case 013 invokes the REAL prefs path in the nested shell (org.gnome.Shell.Extensions.OpenExtensionPrefs on the private bus, the same call openPreferences() makes), then asserts there is NO prefs/Adw error in the shell log and screenshots the prefs window. Keep the 008 spy that the gear handler calls openPreferences(). RED if prefs.js throws under the running Adw, GREEN after the fix. Live journal only as a fallback if it loads clean headlessly yet still fails in the real session

features.title: Install docs: one Strata extension at a time
features.description: install.sh must tell the user to disable strata@edu4rdshl.dev and enable strata-ui@elijahlynn.net (Extensions app or the gnome-extensions CLI), and that Wayland needs a log out / back in before a brand-new extension can be enabled. Running both extensions makes them fight over daemon supervision, the Ctrl+Alt+C binding, and clipboard capture.
steps: install.sh prints, in order: log out/in on Wayland first, then disable strata@edu4rdshl.dev, then enable strata-ui@elijahlynn.net, then Ctrl+Alt+C to toggle
If strata@edu4rdshl.dev is currently enabled, install.sh warns about the conflict
TEST: verify.sh case 014 statically asserts install.sh references disabling strata@edu4rdshl.dev and enabling strata-ui@elijahlynn.net

features.title: Harness: run the full regression suite every slice
features.description: Regressions are currently caught only if the agent remembers to re-run neighbouring cases by hand (verify.sh runs a single id; coding-prompt.md only requires the current id). Make the full suite enforced. BUILD THIS FIRST (before 010-014) so every later slice is gated by it, even though its id is higher than theirs.
steps: verify.sh grows an 'all' mode: `bash test-harness/verify.sh all` runs the case for every feature id that has a case block, prints a per-id PASS/FAIL summary, and exits non-zero if ANY case fails
coding-prompt.md step 5 (and the Red step) require `verify.sh all` to be green before flipping passes / committing, not just the current id
AGENTS.md regression rule points at `verify.sh all`
TEST: `verify.sh all` on the current tree runs all built cases and the summary lists every id; temporarily breaking one case makes the run exit non-zero (then revert the break)

features.title: Test clipboard corpus (3 of each claimed type)
features.description: Every verify case rolls its own inline, almost-all-TEXT stub; there is no shared corpus and no case ever loads a REAL image — which is exactly why the image paste-back bug shipped (the binary path was never exercised). Build one reusable corpus of realistic clipboard items — 3 of EACH claimed type, with REAL bytes — plus a loader the cases share. 'Claimed types' are taken FROM THE SOURCE, not invented: the union of docs/reference/strata-daemon-dbus-contract.md ('Supported MIME'), strata@edu4rdshl.dev/extension.js _pickMime PREFERRED allowlist, and the cardTypes extension/ui/card.js classify() renders (image, file, link, color, text). The corpus covers plain text, html, rtf, markdown, file (text/uri-list + gnome-copied-files), raster images (REAL small PNG bytes plus jpeg/gif/bmp/webp), the link regex card (real URLs) and the color regex card (real #hex). The loader seeds the corpus into the throwaway daemon via SubmitItem (preferred — exercises capture + storage + thumbnailing, including the real binary image path) or stubs the shelf's _fetchPage seam with it.
steps: test-harness/corpus/ holds 3 realistic items of each claimed type with REAL bytes: real small PNGs (and jpeg/gif/bmp/webp), real text/uri-list and gnome-copied-files, real html/rtf/markdown/plain-text, 3 real URLs, 3 real #hex colors, described by manifest.json (file, mime, expected cardType)

test-harness/corpus/loader.js exposes a loader callable from verify cases: seedViaSubmit(baseDir, proxy, cb) pushes each item's raw bytes into the daemon via SubmitItem (images go through the binary ay path), and stubFetchPage(shelf, baseDir) builds ItemMeta[] from the corpus and overrides the shelf seam for daemon-free classification/render asserts

TEST FIRST: verify.sh case 016 loads the corpus and asserts each type classifies to the correct cardType and renders its type-specific body — image -> thumbnail container, file -> filename, link -> hostname subtitle, color -> swatch, text (incl. html/rtf/markdown) -> St.Label — and that real PNG bytes (\x89PNG magic) reach the daemon via SubmitItem. RED before the corpus/loader exists, GREEN after
TEETH: breaking a renderer or the loader turns case 016 RED; restoring it returns green

Image paste-back is NOT asserted here: pushing a REAL image through full paste-back exposes the known image-paste bug ('No compatible transfer format found'), which is a separate slice — case 016 asserts image RENDERING only and records the image-paste gap as a follow-up

features.title: Copy image also offers a file path (paste into text apps)
features.description: When an image is copied, Strata ALSO writes a text file:// path to a temp file holding the image, alongside the image bytes. A VTE/text terminal (GNOME Console, and Claude Code in it) cannot accept an image on paste from ANY clipboard source (confirmed: even GNOMEs native screenshot clipboard fails into KGX), so a file path is the only way to get an image into a text target. Image-accepting apps still take the bytes. Decided: always offer the path, not behind a setting. DO NOT BUILD until directed.
steps: On image paste-back, save the image to a temp file (e.g. ~/.cache/strata/paste/<id>.<ext>) and offer BOTH the image bytes AND its file:// path as text (text/uri-list + text/plain)
Pasting an image into a text terminal yields the file path; into an image app yields the image
TEST: activate an image corpus item; read the clipboard as a text client and assert the file:// path; as an image client and assert the bytes; teeth-proven
Clean up temp files (unlink on next copy / on disable)
